occurrences.snippet: Just as the Gītā of Kṛṣṇa, lord of yoga, is dear to people, so the Kṛṣṇā bānsurī is dear to those who have faith in music.

occurrences.subsection_title: The Kinds of Bānsurī and Suitable Materials
occurrences.snippet: Hence the bānsurī is seen in the world in three kinds, resting on the three guṇas; their names are Tripurā, Kṛṣṇā and Jihvāvatī.
